description: imagepeek: Resize an image. For several sizes in one call use image_thumbnail; for a box or ratio use image_crop. Returns the image resized to `width` and/or `height` (or by `scale`) with `fit` inside (default), contain (letterboxed on `background`), cover (centre crop) or fill (stretched), Lanczos by default; never upscaled unless `upscale` is true (then `upscale_prevented` says so). Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-resize-api.html

fit.description: With width and height: inside (default; fit within, keep aspect), contain (fit within, padded to the exact box), cover (fill the box, centre crop) or fill (stretch).
fit.title: Fit

format.description: Output format (default: the input's; ICO in, PNG out).
format.title: Format

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

output.description: base64 (default): the file comes back inline as base64. url: the file is stored for 24 hours and the reply carries a download link (url, expires_at, bytes, content_type, sha256) instead of the base64, which keeps the file out of your context window.
output.title: Output

resample.description: Resampling filter: nearest, box, bilinear, hamming, bicubic or lanczos (default).
resample.title: Resample

upscale.description: Allow output larger than the input.
upscale.title: Upscale

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url

width.description: Target width in pixels (1-32768); give width, height, both, or scale.
width.title: Width

name: image_resize

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

title: imagepeek: resize an image
